title: Senior Software Engineer – Workflow (.NET) | Global Employer Services Technology Center (GESTC)
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Senior Software Engineer – Workflow (.NET) | Global Employer Services Technology Center (GESTC)**
We are looking for an experienced Senior Software Engineer to join the Workflow team within Deloitte Tax in India’s Global Employer Services Technology Center (GESTC). You will design, build, and support the workflow automation capabilities of the GES platform using .NET / C#, REST APIs, microservices, and event-driven integration with Kafka, helping streamline business processes, modernize existing components, and deliver reliable, reusable platform services.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings 8 to 12 years of hands-on .NET development experience, including meaningful exposure to workflow or business process automation. You have strong engineering fundamentals, work well independently with minimal supervision, and collaborate and communicate effectively with your own team, other product teams, business users, and global delivery partners.
  
  
Experience with Pega or other workflow and low-code platforms (such as ServiceNow, Appian, or Salesforce), as well as AI engineering, Python, and AWS cloud technologies, is a plus and will help you stand out.
  
  
**Key job responsibilities:**

* Own the design and delivery of small to medium complexity workflow automation modules end to end, from technical design and estimation through development, testing, deployment support, and production support.
* Build services and components using .NET / .NET Core / C#.
* Design and consume REST APIs and microservices across internal and external platforms.
* Develop event-driven integration pipelines using Kafka or similar messaging technologies.
* Implement workflow capabilities such as process state management, routing and approvals, business rules, SLAs, and notifications.
* Analyze and resolve production defects, performing root-cause analysis and driving fixes that prevent recurrence.
* Conduct code and design reviews for peer engineers, and ensure adherence to engineering standards, CI/CD practices, and application security requirements.
* Improve application stability, performance, and maintainability, and contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering practices.
* Contribute to solution architecture discussions, particularly for workflow, integration, and reusable platform components.
* Collaborate with Product Managers, Architects, Technical Program Managers, Engineering Managers, business stakeholders, and global delivery teams.
* Mentor and coach junior engineers within the team.
* Take ownership of assigned modules and workstreams, solving problems independently with minimal supervision.
* Support modernization and innovation efforts, including AI-assisted code generation, AI-enabled automation, and AWS cloud-native services, where applicable.

Shift Timings: 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM
  
  
Location: Hyderabad
  
  
**Education/Background:**

* UG: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or in a related discipline.
* PG: Master’s degree in a relevant field is preferred, but not mandatory.

**Desired Skills:**

* 8 to 12 years of hands-on enterprise software development experience, with strong recent experience in .NET / .NET Core / C# (including ASP.NET Core Web APIs).
* Experience building workflow or business process automation solutions, such as task and case management, approvals, or rules-driven and state-based processes.
* Experience with integration technologies such as REST APIs, microservices, Kafka, and event-driven architecture.
* Strong understanding of application design, debugging, performance optimization, and production support.
* Strong SQL and data design skills, with experience in relational databases and ORM frameworks (such as Entity Framework).
* Experience with automated unit testing, source control, and CI/CD practices.
* Effective communication and collaboration skills.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently, within small agile teams, and across larger distributed teams.
* Hands-on experience with a workflow or low-code platform such as Pega, ServiceNow, Appian, or Salesforce, particularly for workflow, case management, or enterprise integration use cases.
* Pega certification (for example CSA, CSSA, or CPLSA / LSA) is a plus.
* Experience with workflow engines or orchestration frameworks (for example Elsa, Camunda, Temporal, or AWS Step Functions).
* Exposure to AI-driven engineering or AI-enabled solution development.
* Working knowledge of Python.
* Working knowledge of AWS services and cloud-native development patterns.
* Experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and modern engineering practices.

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

* Architect low-latency APIs powering the consumer app, rider app, and internal ops dashboards.
* Integrate third-party services: payment gateways, logistics partners, notification providers, and brand catalogue feeds.
* Drive engineering quality — code reviews, testing, observability (Sentry, CloudWatch), and mentoring junior engineers.

* 6+ years backend experience, 3+ years with Django in production.
* Deep PostgreSQL expertise — query optimisation, indexing, partitioning, migrations.
* Strong AWS hands-on: RDS, ElastiCache, SQS/SNS, ECS/EC2, S3, VPC.
* Experience with caching (Redis), async tasks (Celery), and event-driven patterns.
